title: Relic Merry-go-round
summary:
Relic Merry-go-round



● 10 random relics will be settled from all 15 relics for a single match.
● A special choice of Stolen Vault is provided instead of Discard in the relic box. A bag of random 10 ~ 20 gold will be dropped as a Stolen Vault.
● Recruiting Probability Table slightly changed
● Doubloon: New coming Relic!
● Time-Space Replica: New coming Relic!
● Stolen Vault: New coming Relic!
● Magic Seed, Shroud of Concealment, Second Chance: returned.
● Pandaren - Hospitality: Invitation cannot be affected by Dismiss.
● Paladin Sword: Tier 3 New Item.
● Manta Style: Upgraded from Tier 3 to Tier 4.
● Fix bugs

Click the title link to check the full update details!
